Oppo Launches Find X10 Pro Max with 200MP Camera in India

Oppo has launched its new flagship smartphone, the Find X10 Pro Max, in India on Thursday, October 22. The device features the industry's first triple 200MP camera system, aiming for 'True-to-Life Imaging'. The Oppo Find X10 will also be launched alongside the Pro Max model. The Find X10 Pro Max is also reported to have an 8,000 mAh battery.
